reason: The case asserts compile-time rejection of invalid compound assignments: incompatible operand types (including nullable and union operands), non-assignable call targets, and use of compound assignment as an expression, plus an incompatible return type. Compound assignment and every exercised binary operator are explicitly supported; the surrounding calls, accesses, constructors, casts, check/trap expressions and declarations are covered. The sole langlib call, ints:fromString, is allowlisted. These are negative checks within the supported grammar/type system, so invalid source does not itself make the case a feature request.
test_design_notes: Assertions are inline @error markers; there are no @args, @panic or @output expectations.
